mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_submission s join edu_task t on t.task_id = s.task_id join edu_course c on c.course_id = t.course_id where c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and s.status = 2 and t.del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from edu_recommendation where status = 1
select dept_id from edu_class where class_id = #{classId} and del_flag = '0'
select head_teacher from edu_class where class_id = #{classId} and del_flag = '0'
select teacher_id from edu_course where course_id = #{courseId} and del_flag = '0'
select class_id from edu_class_student where user_id = #{userId} and is_current = '1' limit 1
